________________________________________________

Build animated websites that react to your mouse movements using the new Claude slash command. Here is the three-step workflow to get it done.

Claude Code just introduced a way to handle design before you write any code. I am walking through a three-step workflow where we build a functional landing page for a lawn care business. The goal is to move beyond static layouts by adding interactive elements, like a character that tracks your cursor across the screen.

This is a practical look at how to use the Claude design command to iterate on your ideas without getting stuck in a loop. Whether you are building for a client or yourself, these techniques show how to integrate custom web animation into a layout without needing to be a developer. It is a clean, no code approach to making your pages feel alive rather than just another template.

_________________________________________
